title: D2P Seam Connection
description: A binary seam connection between exactly two seam interfaces (design decision ADR-007.1). Multi-party relationships are expressed by sewing groups, never by connections with more than two interfaces. An interface is used by at most one active connection (D2P-SEM-023).

seamConnection.title: Seam connection
seamConnection.description: Connects side A (first interface) to side B (second interface). A traversed in its direction corresponds to B traversed in its direction.

id.description: Stable element ID of the seam connection.

interfaceIds.description: Exactly two distinct seam interface IDs: side A, then side B.

active.description: Whether the connection is active. Inactive connections are kept but not sewn.

matchPoints.description: Notch pairs that must meet when sewing. Omitted when there are none.

validationRuleId.description: Optional validation rule that checks this seam (for example d2p:seam-length-match). Extensible: a d2p: value is a rule ID of the standard 1.0 rule vocabulary (vocabularies/validation/rules), other rules use extension names. An unknown d2p: rule ID is a schema error.

extensions.description: Optional namespaced extension blocks (§1.7 of the schema catalog).

seamEase.title: Seam ease
seamEase.description: How length differences between side A and side B are absorbed. 'amount' is forbidden when mode is 'none' and required otherwise (schema-enforced). Negative amounts are allowed.

amount.description: Expression wrapper; the expression MUST have dimension length (expected length of side A minus side B) (checked at semantic level, D2P-SEM-002).

matchPoint.title: Match point
matchPoint.description: A pair of notches, one on each side, that must meet.

notchIdA.description: Notch on side A: on an edge interval of interfaceIds[0] (D2P-SEM-025).

notchIdB.description: Notch on side B: on an edge interval of interfaceIds[1] (D2P-SEM-025).
